svg.title: Complete six-transistor SRAM standby-leakage testbench
svg.desc: Six MOS transistors with explicit bulk ties form a cross-coupled SRAM cell. A zero-volt word-line source disables both access gates. Three ideal series ammeters separately measure the cell VDD supply and two independent bit-line clamps at VDD. PMOS bodies connect to VDD_CELL after the supply ammeter; all NMOS bodies connect to VSS. Q and QB are unforced. Crossings with bridges are not connected.
svg.text: DC hold • separate cell and bit-line current measurements • explicit MOS bulk connections
DC hold: VWL = 0; VBL = VBLB = VDD; VSS = 0. Use nominal or retention VDD.
Initialize Q = 1, QB = 0; repeat for the opposite state. Q and QB remain unforced.
Bulk wires shown: NMOS → VSS; PMOS → measured VDD_CELL. Dots = connections; bridges = no connection.
A = ideal zero-burden ammeter. Blue arrows define positive current into the cell.
Icell,stby = I(VDD); Pstby = VDD × [I(VDD) + I(BL) + I(BLB)] at the shown biases.
